item: ACK1 (TNK2) and ITCH as regulators of WWOX protein stability (Q1 complement): dasatinib and bosutinib as paired ACK1 probes, conditional on WWOX protein being present
reason: Q1 complement (IT10 P2.3): Q1 has no graph route, and a complementary search for regulators of WWOX protein stability yields one usable slice, a mechanism experiment on protein level only. ACK1 over-expression with an engineered activated kinase phosphorylates WWOX, predominantly at Tyr287, and is followed by polyubiquitination, mostly in HEK293T cells (endogenous Wwox ubiquitination in LNCaP appears only after MG-132, and the ubiquitin assays are under MG-132 pretreatment); degradation as a consequence of Tyr287 phosphorylation is inferred, not shown (PMID 16288044, Mahajan 2005, full text read at the original on 2026-10-31, receipt FTR-20261031-16288044-01, Figs 1-8 inspected, supplement unavailable: phosphorylation and polyubiquitination are shown in overexpressed non-neural cells with an engineered activated kinase; Tyr287 is the predominant, not the only, phosphorylation site by pTyr signal; the paper does not show that Y287F resists ubiquitination or degradation, Fig 5E has no lane without activated Ack1 and one time point, Fig 5F shows MG-132-revealed ubiquitination and no level rescue so the proteasomal route is inferred, and no ACK1 inhibitor is measured against WWOX); ACK1 shRNA raised WWOX in one HCC line (MHCC-97H), one construct versus scrambled, steady state only (PMID 25738261, full text read 2026-10-30 in IT11 P2.4; it supports ONLY the direction 'knockdown raises WWOX', not the Tyr287 or ubiquitin route). Two catalogued ATP-site inhibitors with measured TNK2 potency (dasatinib, bosutinib; multi-target SRC/ABL kinase inhibitors that share SRC/ABL targets and bind SRC tighter than ACK1: concordance of the two does not identify ACK1 and bosutinib is not an independent chemotype; IT11 P2.4) would be paired probes with the concordance rule (agreement with TNK2 knockdown, a response to one only is off-target); the repeated ChEMBL values (bosutinib 2.7 nM, dasatinib Kd 5.6 and 6.0 nM) are literature values carried between papers, not replicates. CONDITIONAL on WWOX protein being present: no model is shown to have a variant protein above the assay floor, and a band not detected in the Q230P fibroblast blot does not separate a protein made and cleared from one never made, so the substrate is UNCONFIRMED, not excluded. Nothing predicts function; ITCH raises WWOX half-life but has no compound. COUNTER-EVIDENCE: the ACK1 observation is cancer-cell over-expression (prostate, liver); no Tyr287 change in serum-starved MEFs; MG-132 raised neither wild type nor the P252A or P282A constructs, so a proteasomal route is not shown in the only variant system, whereas chloroquine and NH4Cl restored P252A and chloroquine also prevented its degradation under cycloheximide (a main-text sentence of PMID 41124647), which supports a lysosomal route; ACK1 inhibition sensitised rat cerebellar granule neurons to apoptotic stress (PMID 37263460, abstract); broad kinase inhibitors shift WWOX phospho-forms in cancer cells. The TNK2 missense that abolishes NEDD4 binding in a family with infantile-onset epilepsy (PMID 23686771, abstract) is NOT counter-evidence for lowering ACK1: the abstract gives no kinase-activity direction and it is one family. CNS exposure and tolerability of both agents were not assessed. Not carded: R3 is satisfied as to the source (Mahajan 2005 and the HCC paper both read) and shows the decisive datum is absent from both, so the unit still waits for a datum that no source holds: a WWOX level, half-life or ubiquitination read after an ACK1-directed intervention including Tyr287Phe, with the no-activated-ACK1 arm and the route arm (ack1_it13_mahajan_20261031/controls_ack1_it13.tsv). Substrate census (IT12 P1-main, 2026-10-31; priority NOT raised, scope narrowed): in published neural WWOX models only wild-type cells (hESC/iPSC neural stem cells and organoids), AAV add-back (wild-type sequence) and one SCAR12 genotype (two siblings, each homozygous for ONE variant, c.1114G>C p.Gly372Arg, a C-terminal missense; its result does not extend to Q230P or to missense variants in general) show any band; the SCAR12 band is faint (0.1 to 0.3 of an unrelated wild type, one membrane) and on a second blot (EV6F, GAPDH loading control; the first blot EV1N uses HSP90) it is similar to the knockout lanes, so it is not shown above the assay floor; the WOREE lines show no visible band (EV1M, where wild-type band saturation is clear; it is mild in EV1N and EV6F). Q230P fibroblast blot: there is a negative control (CRISPR knockout clones) and three positive cancer/HEK lines, but no healthy fibroblast control and no heterozygote lane, and the epitope of the antibody sc-20528 is not stated. lde/lde rat: a trace frameshift product with a newer antibody (HPA050992, aa 32 to 110); that the earlier 'null' call depended on the antibody is the authors' hypothesis, not a demonstrated fact, and the paper gives 'lower mobility' in the Results but 'slightly heavier' in Discussion and legend (46.2 kDa; frameshift product predicted +0.8 kDa). Conclusion: no model has a protein level shown above the assay floor; the substrate for a stability lever is UNCONFIRMED, not excluded; the G372R line is the one model to retest first, after gate G0 (two antibodies, knockout floor). Q1 unit text: the reference class allele Q230P has no band in one non-neural line, no matched control, antibody sc-20528; made-and-cleared versus not made is open; the only neural lines with a missense allele are G372R (SCAR12) and G137V (WCH, iPSC only).
what_would_reopen: the reopenable searches R1 to R7 in triggers.tsv (rows R*_q1_complement): above all R3 (full text of Mahajan 2005 and the HCC paper), R2 (WWOX protein or half-life after ACK1 inhibition or TNK2 loss in a neural or variant-allele cell) and R1 (whether the Q230P protein is made and cleared); a card and a mechanism-probe unit would be created only after R3 or R2

item: Benzodiazepine-site positive modulation of fast GABA-A inhibition: clobazam and its metabolite N-desmethylclobazam as ex vivo probes (compensation of a measured inhibitory loss)
reason: A function-first probe-level hypothesis of IT14 P3, not carded. Generated by the largest knockout-specific effect stated in Breton 2021 (sIPSC amplitude about -52 percent in layer II/III pyramidal cells of the neuron-deleted neocortical slice); inferred: that the loss is receptor-limited rather than release-limited and that a potentiator can restore enough charge (the knockout amplitude is about 48 percent of control and in recombinant receptors the metabolite's maximal potentiation is 143 to 253 percent of the GABA response at EC10 in rat HEK293 cells and 203 to 270 percent at EC20 in human oocytes, readouts that are not directly comparable). Counter-evidence and limits: heterozygote-versus-wild-type inhibition is not reported and the heterozygote bursts in 4 of 23 slices; excitatory-gain and intrinsic (input resistance, sag) readings stay live; sIPSC was recorded with a KCl internal solution; subtype selectivity of both agents is disputed across three primary papers (efficacy ratio alpha2/alpha1 of the metabolite 1.77 in rat HEK293 cells, a comparison that confounds the alpha subtype with the beta subunit (alpha1beta2gamma2 against alpha2beta3gamma2); non-selective in human oocytes, modest alpha2 affinity preference in binding); no GABAergic drug has been tested in any WWOX preparation. Identity: ChEMBL CHEMBL70418 (clobazam) and CHEMBL2260842 (N-desmethylclobazam, listed as NOR-CLOBAZAM); label and exposure facts are not carried here; ex vivo probe use only, no systemic or paediatric claim and no dose.
what_would_reopen: not a precondition for a class-level ex vivo arm; E0 locus data, heterozygote-versus-wild-type sIPSC data or a same-system subtype comparison change how a result is attributed (triggers NP3P1 to NP3P3)

item: GluN2B negative allosteric modulators at the ifenprodil site (ifenprodil and Ro 25-6981 as tools, radiprodil as clinical-stage comparator) as ex vivo probes of the NMDAR contribution to slice bursting
reason: IT15 Q-A target-first search (ChEMBL, graded same-document comparisons) with independent verification.
